mcqs.question: How many awardees were selected for the Jeevan Raksha Padak Awards 2025?
mcqs.explanation: A total of 30 awardees were selected for the Jeevan Raksha Padak Awards 2025. The figure 18 refers specifically to the Jeevan Raksha Padak category, while 6 refers to each of the Sarvottam and Uttam categories.
